answer: Clone keys often share one coal invoice. Mechanism: reserve one 13-minute night heat at a published glacier-terminus forge. Heat a 210 g rivet to (H(pubkey||hearth_id||slot) mod 180)+720 C, quench in runoff, then take a 2.4 GHz radio echo off the rivet into the 5 ns bin from that hash. Cost is 87 locked units. Three peers replay pyrometer and radar logs and reject any refund path already on a live heat. A miss beyond 8 C, a missed slot, or a reused hearth-id burns 23 units and cools the key eight epochs; a second miss or cloned cooling curve forfeits the lock for fourteen epochs.
